lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like distribution of circular high-luminance spots posterior to the gills, organized into distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular centroids, creating a lattice or grid-like appearance in the mid-body section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper two-thirds of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately six distinct, high-luminance blobs are distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, showing a lower spatial density compared to the main flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of smaller, heterogeneous high-luminance spots is visible on the distal and leading edges of the left pectoral fin.
